summary: ObjectGenome.identityParts() is a documented stable-identity supplier but reads schemaVersion/familyId/familyVersion/variantKey through normal caller indexing without first enforcing the canonical plain-data boundary. A metatable-backed caller can therefore execute __index and synthesize canonical-looking identity parts even though identityKey()/inspect() otherwise fail closed on that data class.
evidence: Docs/OBJECT_GENOME.md defines familyId + familyVersion + variantKey + schemaVersion as the complete ObjectGenome v1 stable identity input and explicitly states ObjectGenome.identityParts() supplies those semantic parts to the locked StableId contract.
Active generation-4 primary PR #361 head 08ce8d7093ceb36a85af58510f65ef8e9b33c154 still implements identityParts() with direct field reads and no validation preflight.

Draft adversarial PR #375 exact head 1065bb0d2ad0f183569f3e160e68189ad24402b1 changes only tests/object_genome_contract_lock.luau (+24/-0) and requires a hostile metatable-backed genome to reject before any __index read.

Canonical CI run 31488981414 passes format, lint, Luau analysis, canonical-randomness audit, shared-domain audits, and Swarm deterministic tests, then fails Pure Luau tests exactly at 'identityParts rejects metatable-backed genomes before field reads'.
